data.name: Spirit Warding
data.description: The reanimated medium can ward himself from other spirits and the grave's call.

raw_tokens.value: The reanimated medium can ward himself from other spirits and the grave's call.

He gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against possession, death effects, and negative energy. This stacks with the bonus to resist possession that mediums gain from having high influence.|!PRECLASS:1,Medium=18
